name: upi-collect-guard
title: UPI Collect Guard
description: Collect-request screen that states "You pay ₹4,999 to…", asks whether the user expects to receive money (a yes becomes a decline-only stop), and flags refund, prize, OLX-buyer and KYC wording, person-to-person collects, unknown requesters and small test amounts before the PIN.

meta.stops: Entered UPI PIN to receive money
mistakes: upi pin to receive money scam
meta.summary: Shows a UPI collect request as the payment it really is and asks whether the user expects money, since a UPI PIN only ever sends money.
meta.server: PSPs and banks must enforce collect rules and fraud checks; treat this as user education before the PIN.
catches: "Enter PIN to receive money" confusion, by asking what the user expects
Refund, prize, buyer and KYC scam wording
Person-to-person collect requests (no longer permitted on UPI)
Requesters not in contacts or not matching the expected name
Small test amounts used to build trust
limits: Heuristic wording and name checks; scams can avoid them
Does not block the UPI app's own PIN screen; it advises before it
Requester names come from what your PSP returns
a11y: Intent question is a roving-tabindex radiogroup with arrow keys
Risks linked via aria-describedby; status is role=status
Choosing "I expect money" moves focus to Decline

sources.label: NPCI – UPI Consolidated Circular v1.0 (18 Sep 2026), 2.16

rules.note: Confirmed: PSPs and UPI apps must ensure collect on person-to-person transactions is not permitted (consolidating OC-220 of 29 Jul 2025, effective 1 Oct 2025). Informational; check NPCI's current circulars.
